title: Who Is She ?
lyrics:
[00:19.77]Oh, who is she?
[00:25.76]A misty memory
[00:32.41]A haunting face, is she a lost embrace?
[00:44.55]Am I in love with just a theme?
[00:50.58]Or is Ayesha just a dream?
[00:57.38]A mystery
[01:03.83]Oh, who is she?
[01:10.07]Oh, who is she?
[01:14.53]A misty memory
[01:22.08]A haunting face, is she a lost embrace?
[01:34.22]I call her name
[01:40.93]Across an endless plain
[01:47.54]She'll answer me
[01:53.58]Wherever she may be
[02:25.68]Oh, who is she?
[02:31.38]A misty memory
[02:37.97]A haunting face, is she a lost embrace?
[02:50.06]Somewhere across the sea of time
[02:56.34]A love immortal such as mine
[03:03.07]Will come to me eternally
[03:16.88]Immortal she
[03:22.31]Return to me
